title: Controlled Goods records availability needs an authorized evidence review
remediation: The designated official and records custodian approve the scoped inventory of controlled goods accountability, assessment and eligibility records. Verify an authorized custodian can locate and account for the records through a synthetic or redacted preparation exercise. Record the handling approval and protected references, with regulator disclosure decisions reserved to the responsible official.

milestones.title: Collect an approved records inventory, a redacted retrieval exercise receipt, and the named authority decision for evidence handling
